package main

import (
	"github.com/pulumi/pulumi-std/sdk/v2/go/std"
	"github.com/pulumi/pulumi/sdk/v3/go/pulumi"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/wedata"
)

func main() {
	pulumi.Run(func(ctx *pulumi.Context) error {
		invokeBase64encode, err := std.Base64encode(ctx, &std.Base64encodeArgs{
			Input: "select * from db",
		}, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = wedata.NewRuleTemplate(ctx, "rule_template", &wedata.RuleTemplateArgs{
			ProjectId:        pulumi.String("1840731346428280832"),
			Type:             pulumi.Int(2),
			Name:             pulumi.String("tf-test"),
			QualityDim:       pulumi.Int(3),
			SourceObjectType: pulumi.Int(2),
			Description:      pulumi.String("for tf test"),
			SourceEngineTypes: pulumi.IntArray{
				pulumi.Int(2),
				pulumi.Int(4),
				pulumi.Int(16),
			},
			MultiSourceFlag: pulumi.Bool(false),
			SqlExpression:   pulumi.String(invokeBase64encode.Result),
			WhereFlag:       pulumi.Bool(false),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
}

## Import



wedata ruleTemplate can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Wedata/ruleTemplate:RuleTemplate rule_template rule_template_id
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
